_comment: Cue tables: sim event -> cue decision. Data-driven law: no tunables in code. Placeholder mechanical names only (owner order). M2 schema: each cue declares its triggering event (identity-mapped until integration), fixture file ref, bus routing, voice params, and an optional duck rule. duck.hold_frames >= engine tick_frames is a structural constraint (one pending fade slot per group node — the release fade is issued from update() after the attack window elapses). M3 headroom policy (data-staged, no limiter in the graph): bus volume_db is budgeted so the engineered worst case in the replay corpus (phase-coherent sfx pressure, replay_cues) stays under -1 dBFS sample peak — the ceiling every gate replay pins with a peak expectation (KB music-production: master ceiling -1 dBTP; mix bus headroom). sfx moved -3 -> -10 dB for that budget on 2026-08-19.
